title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are grappling with a mix of operational challenges and strategic shifts. From drone threats to bankruptcy filings, the landscape is anything but dull.

themes.title: Drone Threats Loom Large
themes.body: With drones posing risks to U.S. rocket launch sites, the industry is on high alert. This adds a layer of complexity to an already intricate launch environment.

themes.title: Bankruptcy Blues
themes.body: EchoStar's subsidiaries filing for bankruptcy highlights the financial strains affecting satellite TV and wireless services. It raises questions about the sustainability of certain business models in the sector.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Space Resilience
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup's $1.4B increase for space resilience reflects a growing recognition of the need for fortified capabilities. This funding could catalyze new initiatives aimed at safeguarding assets in orbit.

themes.title: Launch Plans Expand Globally
themes.body: Latitude's upcoming launch from Oman signals a diversification of launch sites beyond traditional hubs. This trend could reshape the competitive landscape as new players enter the fray.
